subtitle: v015 policy-quality current-state view: E-FI-84 live-confirms sensor authority; E-FI-85 closes explicit Repair/Noisy ZMP applicability carriers offline.
currentStatus: The pre-fix model_2000 lineage remains evidence-only. E-FI-84 live-confirms sealed Repair/Noisy contact-wrench evidence, exact-one update and strict checkpoint-v5 model_1.pt.
